heading.title: Of Penalties in Case of Dishonour of Certain Cheques for Insufficiency of Funds in the Accounts3

article.title: Offences to be compoundable.
article.content:
147Offences to be compoundable.

Section 147  ·  Chapter XVII  ·  page 31 of the Act
Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974),every offence punishable under this Act shall be compoundable].
